Free Pk. Recertification Offer In Direct Mail
Hi Joe,
I just left a message for you. Here's why I was calling. (I believe that Loren and Margie will be
bringing this up in your 3:00 meeting today.)
When reading the note below, can you please keep in mind that Brand will need a decision on this
by Monday 8/30 in order to meet scheduling dates in Richmond.
BACKGROUND
The approved recertification plan calls for delivering a free pack coupon to all consumers who
provide GIID. Obviously, this offer is prohibited in Utah, MN and King county. I'm hoping (very
much) that we have the flexibility to develop recert. offer-language that can be used nationally,
versus having to version based on where consumers live. For example, l'm hoping can we continue
to promote the free pack coupon, but in disċlaimer copy (i.e. where it mentions that you must be 21+,
what the exp. date is, etc.) state something like "Offer void in UT, MN and King County, as prohibited
by law. Eligible consumers will receive a free pack coupon upon the purchase of one pack of
Marlboro.
This will make the entire production process easier, more manageable, and less costly.
IMPLICATIONS
If, going forward, brands have to create a separate recertification version, they can be faced with
doubling the number of cells; possibly restructuring the standard package direct mail coupon offers;
and in some cases, diluting or sacrificing learning's.
